text:
liz: quick one — we keep getting feature asks from DP leads that blow out scope. can we agree a short triage + launch checklist to avoid late rework?
omar: absolutely. we need a 3-tier intake (research -> beta -> pilot) and a fast decision SLA.
priya: +1. propose each tier has explicit "must-have" acceptance criteria and an owner. also add a rollback gate. :thinking_face:
dan: sounds good. can we make the decision matrix data-driven? like required usage signal, security ok, and infra cost estimate.
tasha: +thumbsup: also add an integration complexity score (1–5). anything >=3 needs product + eng alignment before commit.
liz: nailed it. rough SLA: ack within 24h, decision and assignment within 5 business days. is that realistic?
omar: yes for core DP leads. for enterprise requests we may need 10 days. add a flag in intake form.
priya: draft intake fields: company, contact, business case, expected qps, data residency, PII? yes/no, desired timeline, preferred tier.
ops-bot: note: we should auto-tag requests that mention "on-prem" or "VPC" for security review.
dan: can we automate initial scoring? small script: 
```
# pseudo logic for intake scoring
score = 0
if expected_qps > 50: score += 2
if integration_complexity >= 3: score += 2
if pii == "yes": score += 3
# tier: score <=1 -> research, 2-3 -> beta, >=4 -> pilot
```
priya: love that. if ops-bot can run the script and append the score to the ticket that speeds decisions.
tasha: for launch criteria for Beta: stable SDK, 1-2 sample customers, automated smoke tests, docs page + quickstart, and monitoring on latency/cost.
liz: add evaluation plan: prompt sets + quality thresholds (BLEU/ROUGE not enough — add human review pass rate).
omar: for pilots we require an SLA ack, dedicated capacity estimate, and rollback plan. also a data handling MOU if customer data is involved.
dan: propose a small invite template for DP asks we can paste into an initial outreach.
priya: please — that will prevent back-and-forth.
liz: here's a short invite template we can use: 
```
Hi {name},

Thanks for your interest in partnering with Redwood for {feature}. We'd love to learn about your goals, target users, and timeline. Can you share: company, contact email, expected usage (qps), data residency needs, whether you'll provide test prompts, and preferred launch tier (research/beta/pilot)?

We'll respond within 24 hours and follow up with a short intake call if needed.

Best,
Redwood DP team
```
tasha: small ask — include a line about NDAs if the customer wants. reduces friction.
priya: agree. also add a checkbox for "willing to share prompts/logs for evals" — important for quality monitoring.
omar: next steps: (1) implement scoring script in the intake form, (2) ops-bot auto-tag rules, (3) one-page triage runbook for on-call and pdm, (4) invite template in sales kit. timeline? 2 weeks for MVP?
dan: 2 weeks okay if eng work is minimal — mostly form + small lambda for scoring. I'll estimate today.
liz: I'll own the runbook and the invite text. @priya please add the acceptance criteria for each tier. @tasha you'll own monitoring + metrics.
priya: on it. will share a short doc with concrete thresholds (quality pass rate, latency p95, cost per 1k tokens).
tasha: I'll define dashboards and alert thresholds. ops-bot will post a reminder to #product in 1 week for progress.
ops-bot: scheduled reminder set for 7 days from now in #product.
liz: thanks all. once we have the MVP we can pilot internally with 2 design partners before offering broadly. goal: reduce intake-to-decision time by 60% and cut scope churn.
omar: :rocket:
